title: The Tenth Circle
author: Jodi Picoult
current_text: In November 2007, some parents challenged The Tenth Circle at Westhampton Beach High School, New York, objecting to its sexual content and requesting its removal from the ninth-grade optional reading list. In December 2007, The Tenth Circle was banned in Westhampton Beach, New York; the Westhampton Beach school board removed it from the ninth-grade reading list after parents objected to what they deemed inappropriate sexual content.

sources.quote:
The Tenth Circle by Jodi Picoult (Simon & Schuster)
Banned in Westhampton Beach, New York, December 2007
The Tenth Circle by Jodi Picoult and Cradle and All by James Patterson (Hachette) were challenged in November 2007 by some parents who objected to sexual content in the books and requested that they be removed from the ninth grade optional reading list at Westhampton Beach High School.

The Westhampton Beach school board voted to remove
 two books from its reading list for ninth-graders and to
conduct a review of the remaining list. The two books, Jodi
Picoult’s The Tenth Circle and James Patterson’s Cradle
and All, attracted the ire of several parents for what they
deemed inappropriate sexual content.
